text: My daily routine is quite simple, and I try to follow it every day. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a short walk. After breakfast, I begin work at nine and stay focused until lunchtime. In the afternoon, I often go to the gym or go running for about an hour. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a little TV, and read a book before bed. I believe consistency is the key to a healthy life, so I stick to this schedule as much as possible.
